rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes image limitations, but it infers a distinct ICM and cohesive TE more confidently than is clearly visible in this single, somewhat out-of-focus image; zona thinning is not specifically assessed from the image.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior IVF outcomes, ectopic/biochemical history, ovarian response, FSH, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the case details; minor overreach exists in morphology-based confidence and the implantation estimate may be somewhat optimistic given the prior history.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst and early monitoring after prior ectopic; minor speculative elements (e.g., broad RIF workup/PGT-A discussion) are presented cautiously.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including luteal support review, ultrasound-guided transfer, early beta-hCG/ultrasound follow-up, and targeted uterine/tubal evaluation if unsuccessful.
